title: Unleash the Power of Spyglass
summary: The powerful Spyglass tool has officially launched, moving beyond beta to empower users with enhanced insights and streamlined operations.

title: Dynamic File Control & Display
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage all your uploaded files and customize their appearance directly within the editor, giving you complete control over your content.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap!
summary: We've launched a brand new public roadmap page to provide full transparency on what we've recently shipped, what's coming next, and what we're planning for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Manage your tasks with greater ease thanks to our newly redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, more clickable, and effortlessly draggable.

title: Effortless Collaborative Editing
summary: We've made working with others more seamless and intuitive, enhancing your real-time collaboration with clearer indicators and effortless interaction.

title: Seamless Sharing & Discovery
summary: Effortlessly discover and collaborate on shared ideas and quests, making it simpler than ever to connect and build together with your friends.

title: Unlock Noeko in Your Language
summary: Soon, you'll be able to enjoy Noeko in a wide array of global languages, breaking down barriers and enhancing accessibility.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's codebase is now fully open source, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in shaping the future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Unleash the full potential of your knowledge base by easily filtering, exploring shared content, and integrating workflows within a dynamic and insightful graph view.

title: Enhanced Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Discover and organize your knowledge with unprecedented precision, leveraging powerful new filters and the ability to save customized views for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Unlock new ways to visualize and interact with your linked content, providing flexible views to intuitively structure your ideas.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and Premium Plans Arrive
summary: Get ready to experience Noeko your way with the upcoming release of self-hosting capabilities and flexible premium plans, empowering you with greater control and valuable features.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Design Refresh
summary: Transform your workspace with our upcoming theme overhaul, featuring improvements to existing designs and the introduction of stunning new visual styles.

title: Smart Greetings for a Perfect Start
summary: Enjoy a more personalized experience with greetings that precisely reflect the time of day, ensuring a warm and accurate welcome whenever you log in.

title: Quick Actions for Tagged Items
summary: Efficiently manage your categorized content with new bulk actions, allowing you to quickly unapply tags, delete, or view items directly from any tag list.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate a wider variety of content, from YouTube videos and websites to text files, to centralize all your essential information and insights in one place.
